'''Ellen Michaliszyn''' is a Star Wars CCG player. They finished 8th in [[DecipherCon 1999 Iron Man]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]<ref name="dc99sw11_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW11_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Iron Man], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031231930/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW11_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>.
